title: Coolify
description: An open-source, self-hostable Heroku & Netlify alternative to deploy apps, databases, and services onto your own servers with zero configuration.
features: One-line curl installation script onto any Linux VPS (Hetzner, OVH, AWS)
Automatic SSL certificate generation via Traefik & Let's Encrypt
Support for Node.js, Next.js, Python, Go, Rust, PHP, and Docker Compose
Managed database instances (Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB)
Git webhook triggers and preview deployments for GitHub and GitLab
pros: Slashes thousands in PaaS cloud bills by utilizing cheap VPS hardware
Zero vendor lock-in with direct access to Docker engine
Active open-source community and rapid release cadence
cons: Requires basic Linux VPS administration and backup management
No built-in global edge multi-region routing without external Cloudflare setup
targetAudience: Indie hackers, homelab enthusiasts, and startups wanting self-hosted PaaS without AWS overhead.
